name: hivam-transport
description: Freight quotes, bilty drafts, trip contribution, detention and weekly transport reports.

interface.longDescription: Prepare transport freight quotes and LR/Bilty drafts, analyse trip contribution, calculate detention and summarise anonymised weekly records. Get branded PDF results and explore HiVAM’s connected transport-office product and vision. The tools do not access customer accounts or execute business actions.
defaultPrompt: Prepare a freight quote from Ahmedabad to Pune for 4000 kg at INR 4.50/kg, with INR 750 loading.
Analyse trip contribution: INR 48000 revenue, 900 km, 250 litres at INR 92, plus INR 3200 tolls.
Help me calculate detention from arrival and release times, free hours and the agreed hourly rate.

positive.prompt: Prepare quote Q1 from Ahmedabad to Pune: 4000 kg at INR 4.50/kg, loading INR 750, discount INR 250 and supplied tax 5%.
positive.expected_behavior: Return an estimate of INR 19,425, itemised assumptions and a branded PDF.

positive.prompt: Prepare a bilty draft D1 dated 2026-11-09 from Example sender in Ahmedabad to Example receiver in Pune: 24 packages of machine parts, 1200 kg, TBB freight INR 8500.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a clearly marked draft without issuing an official LR number or creating account records.

positive.prompt: Analyse trip T1: INR 48000 revenue, 900 km, 250 litres at INR 92, tolls INR 3200, driver allowance INR 1800, loading INR 1500.
positive.expected_behavior: Return INR 29500 entered costs and INR 18500 contribution, with missing-cost caveats and a branded PDF.

positive.prompt: Calculate D1 detention: arrival 2026-11-09T08:00:00+05:30, release 2026-11-09T18:30:00+05:30, four free hours, INR 500 per started hour.
positive.expected_behavior: Return 10.5 elapsed hours, seven billed hours and INR 3500.

positive.prompt:
Summarise week 2026-11-09 from this anonymised CSV: date,reference,status,revenue,cost,pod
2026-11-09,A,delivered,48000,29500,yes
2026-11-10,B,delivered,22000,16500,no
positive.expected_behavior: Return two delivered rows, INR 70000 revenue, INR 46000 cost, INR 24000 contribution and one delivered row missing POD.

negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this integration cannot access customer accounts.

negative.prompt: Pay this carrier and dispatch our live trucks.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not perform payment or dispatch; no such capability is exposed.

negative.prompt: Issue an official e-way bill and reserve an LR number.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the draft-only boundary; do not claim registration or number reservation.

publication.release_notes: Initial HiVAM Transport integration: five isolated transport utilities, product/subscription/media guides and branded PDF exports.
